prompt: Plugin authors have asked to hear about renames. Please add a plugin event, layerrename, that fires whenever a layer's name changes, whether through the palette, the layers panel, or an undo or redo of a rename. They have asked for { id, before, after }: the layer, its old name and its new name. List it with the other events in the plugin reference.
reference: Emits layerrename from the document's change events, comparing each layer's name with the one plugins last heard; the host sends { id, before, after } to plugins with the export capability and { id } to the rest.

naive.summary: The same event with { id, before, after } emitted to every plugin, as the existing events are, so a plugin without export reads layer names.
